h1: Best blinds and shutters in Leeds: 3 local companies
list_label: blinds and shutters companies in Leeds
checks: Get a free home measure, and ask whether fitting is included in the price.
Ask about the guarantee on the blind or shutter and on the motor, if it is electric.
For children's rooms, ask for cordless blinds or child safety devices.

ul: Roller blinds: simple, good value, and available in blackout fabric
Venetian blinds: wood, faux wood or aluminium slats you can tilt
Vertical blinds: common for wide windows and patio doors
Roman blinds: fabric folds for a softer look
Perfect fit blinds: fixed to uPVC frames with no drilling, popular on tilt and turn windows
Plantation shutters: solid louvred panels, the most expensive option but long lasting

p: Looped blind cords can be a danger to young children. For bedrooms and playrooms, ask for cordless designs, or for cords and chains to be fixed out of reach with a safety device. If you have older blinds with loose cords, ask the fitter to make them safe while they are there.

Made to measure companies normally send someone to measure every window, show samples and give a fixed quote. Fitting is often included. Recess or exact fit matters, as does whether the blind will clear handles. Ask how long manufacture takes, as shutters can take several weeks.

Motorised blinds and shutters can be set on timers or controlled from a phone. They are useful for high or hard to reach windows and roof lights. Ask whether the motor needs mains power or a rechargeable battery, and what the guarantee on the motor is.

guide.h2: Bespoke blinds, curtains and shutters in Leeds
p: Most Leeds blinds companies offer a range of blinds to suit every room: roller blinds, Venetian blinds, vertical blinds, Roman blinds, pleated blinds and perfect fit blinds, along with curtains and plantation shutters. Bespoke blinds are made to measure for each window, so a fitter will measure on the visit and come back to fit them. Ask to see blackout options for bedrooms and fabric samples in your own light.

faqs.q: Are made to measure blinds worth it?
faqs.a: For an exact fit, odd sized windows and bays, yes. Ready made blinds are cheaper but often leave gaps that let light in.

faqs.q: How long do shutters take to arrive?
faqs.a: Many shutters are made to order and can take several weeks. Ask at the measure visit.

faqs.q: Do blinds companies fit for free?
faqs.a: Many include measuring and fitting in the price. Ask so you can compare quotes on the same basis.

faqs.q: What is the best blind for a bedroom?
faqs.a: A blackout roller or Roman blind, ideally fitted in the recess with side channels, blocks the most light.
